description: Deletes a specific comment action (identified by `idAction`) from a Trello card (identified by `idCard`); this operation is irreversible and only affects comments.

inputSchema.description: Defines the parameters required to delete a specific comment from an action on a Trello card.

idAction.description: The ID of the comment action to be deleted. This identifies the specific comment within the card's activity.
idAction.title: Id Action

idCard.description: The ID or shortLink of the Trello card from which the comment will be deleted.
idCard.title: Id Card

inputSchema.title: DeleteCardCommentRequest

name: delete_card_comment

DeleteCardCommentResponse.description: Represents the outcome of the request to delete a comment from a Trello card action.

value.description: DELETE operations in Trello API return an empty or null-like response body. Success is indicated by HTTP 200 status code rather than response body content.
value.title: Value
